scope: Documentation only; conditional adoption remains held. No runtime build or corpus execution.

commands.command:
@'
import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
paths = [
    'docs/adr/0026-language-foundation-stability-contract.md',
    'docs/architecture.md',
    'docs/modeling-workspace-phase1-design.md',
    'docs/semantic-kernel.md',
    'verification/summaries/final-language-acceptance/stability-adoption-review.md',
    'verification/summaries/final-language-acceptance/query-cache-observation-review.md',
]
checked = 0
for name in paths:
    path = root / name
    content = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in content.splitlines()), name
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', content):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith('mailto:'):
            continue
        relative, _, fragment = target.partition('#')
        linked = (path.parent / relative).resolve() if relative else path
        assert linked.exists(), (name, target)
        checked += 1
        if fragment and linked.suffix == '.md':
            headings = re.findall(r'^#{1,6}\s+(.+)$', linked.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), flags=re.M)
            slugs = [re.sub(r'[^\w -]', '', heading.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for heading in headings]
            assert fragment in slugs, (name, target)
adr = (root / paths[0]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert adr.startswith('# ADR 0026: language foundation stability contract\n\nStatus: proposed;')
adr27 = pathlib.Path('docs/adr/0027-compositional-semantic-publication.md')
assert 'Status: proposed research architecture; not adopted and not current publication' in adr27.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', str(adr27)]) == b''
coverage = json.loads(pathlib.Path('standards/v2-coverage.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for key in ('claim', 'modeling_platform_gate', 'sysml_systems_library_publication', 'compositional_semantic_publication', 'kerml_canonical_publication', 'legacy_release_register'):
    assert key in coverage, key
assert coverage['modeling_platform_gate']['result'] == 'gated'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--', 'standards/v2-coverage.json', 'standards/coverage.json', 'verification/traceability.json']) == b''
content_digest = hashlib.sha256()
for name in paths:
    content_digest.update(name.encode('utf-8') + b'\0' + (root / name).read_bytes())
print(json.dumps({'documents': len(paths), 'relative_links': checked, 'conditional_status': 'preserved', 'coverage_and_adr0027': 'unchanged', 'documentation_content_sha256': content_digest.hexdigest(), 'python': sys.version.split()[0]}))
'@ | python -
